one_line: Poet of Gitanjali, Nobel laureate, and visionary founder of Santiniketan and Visva-Bharati.

appearance.age_look: Looks around 50–60, tall and slightly stooped, with a calm, contemplative scholar’s build.
appearance.face: Long, oval face with high forehead, deep-set thoughtful eyes under heavy brows, prominent straight nose, full moustache blending into a long beard, medium wheatish complexion, default expression serene and introspective with a gentle, faraway gaze.
appearance.hair: Thick, shoulder-length wavy grey hair parted slightly off-centre, brushed back from the forehead without oil, with a simple narrow off-white cloth headband occasionally implied but usually bare-headed.
appearance.costume: Wears an early-20th-century Bengali scholar’s attire: a full-length, long-sleeved cream cotton kurta reaching mid-calf with a modest round collar and side slits; over it a loose, ankle-length dark indigo woollen chadar-like robe (in the Visva-Bharati style, cut like a simple open-front gown) with slightly wide sleeves and a subtle woven border; below, plain off-white dhoti tied traditionally and falling to the ankles, and simple brown leather sandals; in colder scenes, the indigo robe is wrapped around him like a shawl, but the default is the robe worn open, showing the cream kurta beneath; no flashy jewellery, just a single thin copper-coloured bangle on the right wrist for a touch of detail.
appearance.signature: A worn, medium-sized, hardbound notebook with off-white pages and a dark brown cloth cover held in his left hand, with a simple wooden fountain pen or dip pen tucked between the pages, often lightly gripped between his fingers.

ref_desc: Rabindranath Tagore is a tall, slightly stooped man in his fifties with a long grey wavy shoulder-length hair, flowing beard and moustache, serene deep-set eyes, wearing a cream kurta, off-white dhoti, ankle-length dark indigo robe, brown sandals, and carrying a dark brown notebook with a simple wooden pen, in a palette of cream, dark indigo, off-white, warm brown, and soft grey.
sheet_prompt: Draw an anime-style full-body model sheet of Rabindranath Tagore: a tall, slightly stooped man in his fifties with a long, oval face, high forehead, deep-set thoughtful eyes, heavy brows, prominent nose, and a full moustache flowing into a long grey beard, with thick wavy grey hair down to his shoulders brushed back from an off-centre part; his default expression is serene and introspective, as if listening to an inner music. Dress him in early-20th-century Bengali scholar’s clothing: a long-sleeved cream cotton kurta reaching mid-calf with a modest round collar and side slits, an off-white dhoti tied traditionally and falling to his ankles, and an ankle-length dark indigo woollen robe like an open-front gown with simple slightly wide sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn loosely over the kurta; put simple brown leather sandals on his feet and a single thin copper-coloured bangle on his right wrist. In his left hand, have him gently hold a medium-sized worn dark brown hardbound notebook, with an off-white page edge visible and a simple wooden fountain or dip pen tucked between the pages as if always ready to write. Use a restrained, dignified palette of cream, dark indigo, off-white, warm brown, and soft grey, and show him from multiple angles (front, side, back) with close-ups of his face, hair, robe and notebook so his design can be redrawn consistently.
